svg.title: How HAYDNsim builds a field: 47 Tucanae
svg.desc: Left: the one degree field as a circle with schematic star marks whose density follows the binned radial profile of the placed stars, the HST normalisation annulus at 50 to 100 arcsec, and the profile itself with a King model of the Harris 2010 shape. Middle: the luminosity function of the delivered TRILEGAL field, 91,629 stars in half-magnitude bins, with the mass, age and metallicity it was built at. Right: a pixel grid at 0.5 arcsec per pixel with one star's point spread function, its six-pixel mask and three neighbours whose light spills into the mask. Below: the noise-to-signal ratio as the quadrature sum of nine terms, the stellar pollution ratio, and the median noise terms of the stars between P 15.7 and 16.0.
